remarks:
Welcome to this stately, impeccably maintained 2-story home on a quiet cul-de-sac with no through traffic! Cherished by the same family for over 50 years, this property is custom-built for both comfortable daily living and effortless entertaining.

Step inside to an inviting entryway foyer that immediately welcomes you home, featuring French doors that lead gracefully into both the charming front sitting room and the kitchen. The cozy sitting room has a gas fireplace set beneath a focal point mantle. The sizable living room flows seamlessly through sliding glass doors directly out to the peaceful outdoor cabana, rebuilt in-ground salt water pool (complete with heater and filtration system!) and expansive, fully fenced backyard. Off the garage, enjoy the fully screened-in veranda for extra multi-season outdoor relaxation.
You'll love the newly added mudroom - a bright & functional space designed to keep everyday life organized & effortless.
Inside, enjoy large bedrooms and a primary suite complete with a dressing area, generous closet space, and an ensuite bath with a walk-in shower. 
You'll also find bamboo flooring in the spacious bathroom on the first floor.
The attached 2-car garage cleverly doubles as additional kitchen/prep space equipped with cabinetry, a sink, and Gladiator shelving that provides optimal storage & organization.
Strong mechanics, abundant storage, and an architectural roof (approx. 15 years old) complete this Lockport gem. 
Don't miss out!
Open House Saturday 10/3 1:00-3:00
